content: We finalized the dataset by selecting one correct and one incorrect answer for each question–text pair. To increase the proportion of non-trivial inference cases, we chose the candidate with the lowest lexical overlap with the text from the set of correct answer candidates as correct answer. Using this principle also for incorrect answers leads to problems. We found that many incorrect candidates were not plausible answers to a given question. Instead of selecting a candidate based on overlap, we hence decided to rely on majority vote and selected the candidate from the set of incorrect answers that was most often mentioned.
